The states of SCR-31 are Loading, list and reviewed, and those of SCR-32 are Out, overdue and returned, as legacy RWB-AD-021 names them. Screen Specifications v1 gives no empty, error or no access state for SCR-31 and no empty, loading, error or no access state for SCR-32, so each of these states is Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-5734, CG-ALL-5735).
